- The block is called FB (function block) with given I/O. We can have internal static variables to remember states across scans: e.g., previous values of inputs (rising edge detection), process step state (idle, openA, openB, openC, mixing, done), previous operation mode, previous level sensor, etc.

- The emergency stop is active when estop = FALSE. In that case, all outputs must be FALSE (valveARun = FALSE, etc.). So we need to handle this: whenever estop is FALSE, set all outputs to FALSE and maybe reset internal state.

- Manual mode: when opeMode = FALSE. In manual mode, the start buttons (valveAStart etc.) cause toggling on rising edge. So we need to detect rising edge of each start button and toggle the respective output. Also ensure that the emergency stop and mode switches can reset outputs. Also we need to ensure that the auto mode is not interfering in manual mode.

- Automatic mode: when opeMode = TRUE. In auto mode, we need to implement the sequential control:

   - Press autoStart button to start the process: on rising edge of autoStart, start valve A.

   - Then wait for levelSensor >= 50 (i.e., 50 cm). At that point, close valve A and open valve B.

   - Then wait for levelSensor >= 80, close valve B.

   - Then if processMode = FALSE (i.e., simple mode): start mixing motor; after receiving mixing complete signal (mixMotorComplete), stop mixing motor, open valve D, and process ends (i.e., after opening valve D, maybe go to idle state). The spec: "Based on processMode: If processMode=false, start the mixing motor; after receiving the mixing complete signal, stop the mixing motor, open valve D, and the automatic process ends. If processMode=true, open valve C; when the liquid level sensor reaches 100cm, close valve C, start the mixing motor; after receiving the mixing complete signal, stop the mixing motor, open valve D, and the automatic process ends."

Thus we need states:

- IDLE: waiting for autoStart.

- FILL_A: valve A open, waiting for level >= 50.

- FILL_B: valve B open, waiting for level >= 80.

- If processMode = false: then after B close, we go to MIX: open mixing motor, wait for mixMotorComplete.

- If processMode = true: after B close, we go to FILL_C: open valve C, wait for level >= 100, then close C and go to MIX.

- After MIX (mixMotorComplete true), we go to DISCHARGE: open valve D, and then process ends (maybe return to IDLE). According to spec: "open valve D, and the automatic process ends." So after opening D, perhaps we can set a state DONE and then after D is opened maybe wait for some condition? The spec says process ends; but D may need to stay open? Typically after discharge, the tank empties, but not needed. We could keep D open until next autoStart or emergency stop. But property S5 says mixing complete signal must cause mixing motor to stop and open valve D. It doesn't say to close D later. We can keep D open.

- In automatic mode, also ensure that only one of valves A/B/C runs at a time, and D runs only after mixing, mixing motor runs only after A/B/C are closed, etc.

- The state machine must be robust: if emergency stop occurs (estop = FALSE), all outputs off, state maybe reset to IDLE (or at least stop everything). - The manual mode toggling must work only when estop = TRUE and opeMode = FALSE. In manual mode, pressing start toggles output.
